gloss: to get off (a vehicle); to alight

definitions.gloss: to get off (a vehicle); to alight; to disembark
definitions.explanation: To exit a train, bus, or other public transport vehicle at a particular stop or station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}の{駅|えき}→次の駅：23576_tsuginoeki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{下車|げしゃ}する。
examples.english: I'll get off at the next station.

examples.japanese: {東京駅|とうきょうえき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{下車|げしゃ}→下車：00068_gesha⟧して⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}えて→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please get off at Tokyo Station and transfer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{終点|しゅうてん}→終点：05457_shuuten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{手前|てまえ}→手前：01001_temae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{下車|げしゃ}→下車：00068_gesha⟧した⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{目的地|もくてきち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧です⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Getting off one stop before the last stop is closer to your destination.

notes:
A formal word for getting off a train, bus, or similar vehicle. In everyday conversation, ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ is more common, but ⟦{下車|げしゃ}→下車：00068_gesha⟧ appears frequently in announcements, signage, and written instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}{下車|げしゃ}→途中下車：27112_tochuugesha⟧: stopover, getting off partway through a journey
- ～⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{下車|げしゃ}する: to get off at ~
- ⟦{下車|げしゃ}→下車：00068_gesha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧: the station where one gets off

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to get off — the everyday word for exiting a vehicle
- ⟦{乗車|じょうしゃ}→乗車：06201_jousha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to board — the opposite, getting on a vehicle
- ⟦{下船|げせん}→下船：21593_gesen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to disembark (from a ship) — used specifically for boats and ships
